headlines.title: The $17 billion DoorDash-Instacart deal puts a spotlight on a16z and Silicon Valley’s rival-board problem
headlines.summary: Sequoia Capital partners sit on the boards of both delivery app companies, an arrangement an antitrust scholar says is likely illegal.

headlines.title: DoorDash (DASH) Brings Ride Rewards And Food Credits Together In Lyft Go
headlines.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) and Lyft have launched Lyft Go, a joint rewards and ordering program linking rides with food delivery credits. The partnership integrates DoorDash restaurant ordering directly inside the Lyft app for eligible users in supported US markets. Lyft Go members receive DoorDash order credits tied to qualifying ride activity, creating a bundled experience across both platforms.

headlines.title: GTA 6 Preorders Hit an Estimated $1.5 Billion. Its Launch Could Boost DoorDash, Hurt Fortnite and Mobile Streaming
headlines.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI comes out Thursday, and players have already spent an estimated $1.54 billion preordering it, according to market intelligence firm Sensor Tower.

headlines.title: The Justice Department Will Review DoorDash’s $17 Billion Instacart Deal
headlines.summary: Instacart shares trade well below DoorDash's cash offer, and a $1.25 billion breakup fee shows the buyer expects a long fight. Which agency takes the case, and what regulators could demand, may decide who profits.

description: DoorDash, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a commerce platform that connects merchants, consumers, and dashers in the United States and internationally. The company operates DoorDash Marketplace, Wolt Marketplace, and Deliveroo Marketplace, which provide various services, such as customer acquisition, demand generation, order fulfillment, merchandising, payment processing, and customer support. It also offers consumer membership programs, DashPass, Wolt+, and Deliveroo Plus; advertising as a value-added service through its marketplaces; and white-label delivery fulfillment services, as well as services that help merchants establish online ordering, build branded mobile apps, manage reservations and in-store dining, manage consumer relationships, enable tableside order and pay, and improve customer support. The company was formerly known as Palo Alto Delivery Inc. and changed its name to DoorDash, Inc. in 2015. DoorDash, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
